s: strI, (vfkzaM BinattIti । Bid + kvip .) vAsI । iti hemacandraH ॥
m: वृक्ष—भिद् f. ‘tree-splitter’, an axe, L.

s: strI, (vfkzaM BinattIti । Bid + kvip .) vAsI । iti hemacandraH ॥

a squirrel, Suśr.

m: वृक्ष—च्छाय n. the shade of many trees, a grove, L.

वृक्ष—चन्द्र m. N. of a king, Buddh.

m: वृक्ष—चर mfn. going or living in trees
वृक्ष—चर m. ‘tree-goer’, a monkey, L.

m: वृक्षक m. a little tree (also बाल-व्˚), Kum.; Vcar.
(esp. ifc. f(आ). ) any tree, R.; Kālid. &c. (cf. गन्ध- and फल-व्˚)
Wrightia Antidysenterica, Car.
वृक्षक n. the fruit of W˚ A˚ Suśr.
a stimulant, L.
a: वृक्षकः — 1 A small tree; Ku. 5. 14. --2 A tree (in general). --3 The Kuṭaja tree.

m: वृक्ष—कन्द m. the bulb of Batatas Paniculata, L.

वृक्ष—कुक्कुट m. ‘tree-fowl’, a wild cock, L.
वृक्ष—मार्जार m. a kind of animal, ib.
वृक्ष—मूल n. the root of a tree, Mn.; R.
वृक्ष—मूल—निकेतन mfn. dwelling at the roots of trees, MW.
वृक्ष—मूल—ता f. lying or sleeping on roots of trees (as a hermit), Kām.
वृक्ष—मूलिक mfn. id. (with Buddhists one of the 12 Dhūta-guṇas or ascetic practices), Dharmas. 63.; Baudh. ii, 18, 24

abounding with trees, consisting of trees, W.

m: वृक्ष—मृद्-भू m. ‘tree-earth-born’, a sort of cane or reed, Calamus Fascicularis or Rotang, L.
वृक्ष—नाथ or वृक्ष—नाथक, m. ‘lord of trees’, the Indian fig-tree, L.
वृक्ष—नाम mfn. having the name of a tree, ĀpGṛ.

वृक्ष—पर्ण n. the leaf of a tree, R.
वृक्ष—पुरी f. N. of a town, Buddh.
वृक्ष—राज् m. = -नाथ, Yājñ., Sch.
वृक्ष—राज m. N. of the Pārijāta tree, Hariv.
वृक्ष—रोपण n. tree-planting, Cat.
वृक्ष—रोपक m. a planter of trees, R.
वृक्ष—रोपयितृ m. = -रोपक, Kull. on Mn. iii, 163.
वृक्ष—रोपिन् mf(इणी)n. planting trees, MBh.

s: strI, (vfkze rohatIti । ruha + kaH । tatazwAp .) vandA । ityamaraH ॥ amftaSravA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

m: वृक्ष—रुहा f. ‘tree-grower’, a parasitical plant whose roots attach them selves to another plant (as Cymbidum Thessaloides, Vanda Roxburghii &c.), L.

वृक्ष—सर्पी f. (prob.) a female tree-serpent, AV.

वृक्ष—त्व n. the state or notion of ‘tree’, Sarvad.

वृक्षोत्थ mfn. growing on a tree, W.

वृक्ष्य n. tree-fruit, ŚBr.
